description: Promote the current live SANDBOX release to production — the gated sandbox→prod path. Refuses unless sandbox is live AND currently healthy (you do not ship a broken sandbox to prod), and the promoted prod release is health-checked with auto-revert. For github and managed apps this rebuilds production from the EXACT sandbox commit; for upload apps, and any sandbox release made by appcrane_deploy_artifact, it copies the exact tested sandbox release. Owner-only (or platform admin).
name: appcrane_promote
